endpoints.result: Raw bytes; client verifies size and bounded response.
result is a string; read only after size check.
result.success, followed by raw byte hash verification.
Single complete BIN/ELF or backup upload; no automatic resume/retry; verify raw saved bytes.
Native acknowledgement followed by parent-list postcondition.

queueFiles.ps4Note: GoldHEN uses [AutoRun] in payloads.ini, not AutoRun.ini. Raw text editor preserves untouched lines, sections and existing line endings. No invented queue/delay syntax.

ps5Manager.constraint: Manager embeds its web assets in the ELF, with no arbitrary local HTML route. Native management APIs require its own origin. The ezRemote workspace does not spoof Origin/Referer or call the manager API. Raw on-disk autoload edits do not prove that any active native sequence has changed.

safeguards: No API requests on page open or tab change; explicit user action required.
Public/incorrect-origin preview stays read-only; writes require a successful native directory read.
Only /data and explicitly supplied verified mount roots may be read. The authored UI stays under /data because ezRemote does not supply authoritative mount verification.
Writes limited to /data/payloads, /data/whatwhatboy, PS5 /data/pldmgr/payloads/local, and exact platform configuration plus unique backup/staging siblings.
No delete, remove, install, payload execution, TCP probe or cross-origin API requests.
BIN/ELF uploads limited to 8 MiB; binary reads 32 MiB; text editor 64 KiB; directory responses 1 MiB/5000 entries.

Every save verifies current hash, uploads and hash-verifies unique original-byte backup, rechecks original, writes/reads a unique stage, rechecks original again, then renames and verifies final bytes. Existing backups and partial stages are retained.
Native file API provides no atomic compare-and-swap. Other native writers must be idle; rechecks reduce but cannot eliminate races.
Rename/createFolder/upload native success can be misleading; client verifies actual postconditions and never retries automatically.
Pinned ezRemote singleFilename copy branch skips regular files; backup never uses /copy.

i18n.mode: Exact static/template subset embedded inline for all twenty translated languages plus English. Local picker, translated prompts, read-only data paths/names/hashes and raw editor protection. No remote language requests or expanded permissions.

validation.browserWorkflow: Root agent owns CUA browser visual/native-origin fixture checks. This generator does not launch browser automation.
validation.compatibility: ES5 syntax; authored Promise fallback; UTF-8 and SHA-256 fallbacks for HTTP console origins; no Array.includes, lookbehind or Number.isSafeInteger requirement.

limitations: Installed native app and compatible homebrew environment required. Firmware support is not inferred from the workspace.
No hardware success claim; all tests use mock APIs/filesystems.
Public host cannot directly manage private console services; install and navigate to the helper’s native origin.
Autoload editor is a raw native-file editor. It does not automatically enable autoload, reorder guessed entries, run a queue or claim live settings applied.
Empty originals are backed up with zero-byte multipart uploads. Empty replacement stages also use multipart to avoid the native FS::Save empty-file handle leak.
Original files/versions and all receiver6701 helpers are unchanged.
